title: Psychology Facts
hook: Can you solve this in five seconds?
facts: A bat and a ball cost *$1.10* together.
The bat costs *$1* more than the ball.
Your gut says *10 cents*. The answer is *5 cents*.
In Shane Frederick's 2005 test, around *half* of students at top universities missed it.
outro: Your gut is fast, but not always right.
